get_2d_sincos_pos_embed: generate a 2D sine-cosine position embedding for a given grid size and embedding dimension
get_2d_sincos_pos_embed_from_grid: compute 2D sine-cosine position embeddings from a pre-built grid using numpy
get_1d_sincos_pos_embed_from_grid: compute 1D sine-cosine position embeddings from position values using numpy
get_1d_sincos_pos_embed_from_grid_torch: compute 1D sine-cosine position embeddings from position values using PyTorch tensors
interpolate_pos_embed: interpolate position embeddings from a checkpoint model to match a new model's patch size
